gloss: poor handwriting; scrawl; hastily written letter

definitions.gloss: poor handwriting; scrawl; hastily written letter
definitions.explanation: messy or careless handwriting, or a letter written in haste; often used as a humble apology for one's own writing

examples.japanese: {乱筆|らんぴつ}⟦ご{容赦|ようしゃ}→ご容赦：06969_goyousha⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{乱筆|らんぴつ}{乱文|らんぶん}⟦にて→〜にて：21803_nite⟧⟦{失礼|しつれい}いたします→失礼いたします：18088_shitsureiitashimasu⟧。
examples.english: I apologize for the messy handwriting and rough composition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|いそ}いで→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{乱筆|らんぴつ}になってしまいました⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お⟦{伝|つた}え→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}います→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I wrote in a hurry so the handwriting is messy, but I believe I got the message across.

notes:
Composed of {乱|らん} (disorder; messy) + {筆|ひつ} (writing brush; writing). This word is most often used as a formulaic humble expression at the end of handwritten letters and notes to apologize for untidy writing. Even when the writer's handwriting is perfectly legible, it functions as a polite self-deprecation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {乱筆|らんぴつ}⟦ご{容赦|ようしゃ}→ご容赦：06969_goyousha⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧: please forgive my poor handwriting
- {乱筆|らんぴつ}{乱文|らんぶん}: messy handwriting and rough composition (paired phrase)
- {乱筆|らんぴつ}⟦にて→〜にて：21803_nite⟧⟦{失礼|しつれい}いたします→失礼いたします：18088_shitsureiitashimasu⟧: I apologize for the poor handwriting
- {乱筆|らんぴつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません→申し訳ありません：21409_moushiwakearimasen⟧: I'm sorry for the poor handwriting

REGISTER:
This is a formal, written expression. It belongs to the tradition of humble self-reference in Japanese letter-writing. It is rarely used in casual contexts and is almost exclusively found in handwritten correspondence.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {乱文|らんぶん}: rough or disorganized composition — often paired with {乱筆|らんぴつ}
- ⟦{悪筆|あくひつ}→悪筆：27028_akuhitsu⟧: bad handwriting — a more direct, less formal description of poor penmanship
